title: Census of India 2011: Primary Census Abstract (population, households, literacy, workers)
publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (Ministry of Home Affairs)
license: Government of India open data (attribution: ORGI, Census 2011)
description: Population, households, children 0-6, literates and workers (main and marginal, by cultivators, agricultural labourers, household industry and other workers) for India, every state, district, sub-district and town, by total / rural / urban; plus the urban agglomerations (catalogue 45261). 2011 is the latest census with published results.
used_for: Population of states, districts and cities
Workers by sector (Food and Production yields)

title: Census of India 2011, A-02: Decadal variation in population since 1901
publisher: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (Ministry of Home Affairs)
license: Government of India open data (attribution: ORGI, Census 2011)
description: Population at every census from 1901 to 2011 for India, each state / UT and each 2011 district, on their 2011 boundaries. Used for growth from 2001 to 2011 and for the long population series.

title: GeoNames gazetteer: India (populated places)
description: Names, alternate names and coordinates of populated places in India. Used only to place census cities on the map; a match must fall inside the city's own census sub-district or district.

title: States, districts and 2011 census sub-districts of India (INDIAN-SHAPEFILES)
publisher: INDIAN-SHAPEFILES project (Akula Datta), compiled from official Indian boundary data
description: Outlines of India's states and union territories, today's districts and the 2011 census sub-districts, drawn on the official boundary of India (Survey of India). Used to decide which state and district each hex belongs to, and to move 2011 census counts onto today's districts. Pinned to commit 08490eaab1.
used_for: District lookup for lenses and the Explorer

title: Natural Earth (countries 1:50m, lakes and rivers 1:10m)
description: Neighbouring countries (Iraq, Turkey, the Caucasus, Turkmenistan, Afghanistan, Pakistan and the neighbouring countries; shown fogged), large lakes and major rivers. Files are pinned to the natural-earth-vector release v5.1.2.
vintage: Natural Earth v5.1.2 (1:50m countries, 1:10m lakes and rivers)

title: Natural Earth 1:10m roads, railroads and ports
description: Freeways, major highways and railroads, as 1:10m line work, plus Natural Earth's ports. Shown as map art (roads and rail between hex centres), not as statistics: the alignment is generalised and carries no traffic or owner data. Files are pinned to the natural-earth-vector release v5.1.2.
used_for: Freeways and major highways on the map

title: OurAirports
description: Airports with scheduled passenger service, by size class (large or medium). Military-only fields are left out.

title: Handbook of Statistics on Indian States (state GDP and value added by sector)
publisher: Reserve Bank of India; figures from the National Statistical Office (MoSPI)
license: Reserve Bank of India publication (free to use with attribution)
description: Gross State Domestic Product, per-capita Net State Domestic Product and Gross State Value Added in agriculture, manufacturing, industry and services, at current prices (base 2011-12), in ₹ lakh (1 lakh = 100,000). States that have not published a year are blank for it.
vintage: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States (21T)

title: Terrain Tiles (Terrarium encoding), zoom 7
publisher: Mapzen / AWS Open Data Registry (from SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1 and others)
license: Open data; see the attribution list at https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md
description: Land elevation and sea depth, about 1 km per pixel, sampled every ~3 km. Each hex's relief (flat, hills, mountains, peaks) comes from the mean and roughness (standard deviation) of the land samples inside it.
vintage: Terrarium tiles, zoom 7, every 3rd pixel (~3 km)

title: Earthquakes of magnitude 5.5 or more since 1900
description: Every earthquake of magnitude 5.5 or more in the USGS comprehensive catalogue since 1900, in the map window around India, queried from the USGS event web service at build time.
vintage: USGS ComCat, M5.5+ since 1900 (retrieved at build)

title: World Heritage sites, national parks and universities in India via Wikidata
publisher: Wikidata (UNESCO, Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, and others)
description: Items in India with the World Heritage Site designation and inscription year; national parks with coordinates and area; universities with coordinates and Wikipedia articles in at least 8 languages. Queried from the Wikidata Query Service at build time.

title: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 (v200)
license: CC BY 4.0. © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium
description: Global 10 m land cover from Sentinel-1 and -2 (2021), resampled (nearest neighbour) to a ~1 km grid. Each hex's biome (forest, scrub and desert, grassland, cropland, wetland, urban, barren, ice) and its land-cover shares come from about 580 pixels inside it.

title: Global Power Plant Database v1.3
description: Power stations with capacity, main fuel and location. The database was last updated in 2021, so plants built since are missing.
